scope: Unit/integration mocks only; not a real model or deployed endpoint evaluation.
limits: Source-record rendering is deterministic; prose fallback detects bounded classes of contradictions and is not a universal semantic checker.
Complete model rounds are buffered before validated SSE chunks, increasing first-content latency.
Technical model accuracy and current/held-out real evaluations remain unverified until AWS authentication is restored.
reviewAttempts: Initial renderer test exposed Credly URLs falsely matching currency S/: fixed URL handling and currency boundary.
Independent review exposed achievement/year misassociation, unknown credentials, current-employer inversions, fabricated confirmation and multi-service line loss: fixed and added regressions.
Next independent review exposed ambiguous source-name false positives and unverified delivery commitments: added subject/context checks and clause-level policy replacement.
Final independent review found booked-slot phrasing after an unrelated negation; added slot/reservation subjects and regression assertion.
